notes.note-2: **13 state invariants** must hold after every mutation: (a) non-empty root; (b) every block has unique key; (c) parent ↔ child pointers consistent; (d) list uniform marker; (e) table figure→table→thead+tbody→tr→th/td→span(cellContent); (f) heading no soft-breaks in atxLine; (g) one front-matter max and first block only; (h) code pre→code→span(codeContent) with lang synced to languageInput; (i) every span has .text .key .functionType; (j) no languageInput siblings in list; (k) task-item has [checkbox + p] children; (l) offset ≤ text.length; (m) no orphan blocks after removal.
notes.note-3: **Known upstream bugs to preserve as regressions (do NOT silently fix during port)**: (a) `exportMarkdown.js:300` pipe-escape misses cell-start; (b) `exportMarkdown.js:303-306` irregular table produces "undefined" literal; (c) `paragraphCtrl.js:116` nested list items without listType; (d) `enterCtrl.js:18` chopBlockByCursor O(n²) perf; (e) `deleteCtrl.js:27` empty-table delete crash (#67). Track each as separate bugfix PR after v1.0.
notes.note-4: **CJK/IME safety** — upstream has NO compositionstart lock in 6 keystroke handlers (R-27). Phase-A1.5 step must add composition flag in ContentState and gate keystroke handlers on `!isComposing`.
notes.note-5: **Parser security footguns** (R-32, R-33, R-34): (a) `partialRender` uses insertAdjacentHTML; (b) reference-def hrefs not sanitized at parse; (c) no recursion limit on blockquote/list/footnote. Port preserves behavior; V-M-010 fixture-xss payloads 23-27 below test mitigation.
notes.note-6: **Parser option flags** — 11 total: gfm, breaks, pedantic, footnote, frontMatter, math, superSubScript, emoji, isGitlabCompatibilityEnabled, disableHtml, smartLists. Contract snapshot test verifies all accepted and behave per plan.
